en.title: About me
en.bio: I’m a product manager who enjoys turning complex, ambiguous problems into clear product direction and usable experiences. My background spans consumer products, AI, and digital healthcare, with hands-on experience across strategy, UX, delivery and iteration.
en.beyond_intro: A more personal corner of the site — a place to share the things I genuinely care about, the stories behind them, and moments I want to remember.
